answer: Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 180 aliases, and each one needs its own funded reef account. Deposits are visible in canyon, and ocean reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 19% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
